regions.merged_text: Your letter and kind favor of Mar. 5 is gratefully acknowledged. Certificates of enrollment in the Seraphic Mass Assn. have been mailed. Glad to hear the good news about your brother in law. May he persevere in God's Holy Grace, and thus eventually gain his eternal reward. With regard to joining a "Third Order" or an order of "Oblates", to the Good Lord, it really doesn't matter which one you join, since you can insure your eternal salvation in any or either one. The important thing is the motive for joining, and the observance of the spirit and rule of the one which you belong. From a human standpoint however, we would be inclined to join the one that has the most appeal to you, since then our human nature would readily conform to the spirit and rule of that order. I would suggest that you obtain information on all three, taking all things into consideration, and after spending sufficient time in prayer and medi- tation, join that one which you feel will do you the most good, in regards to your eternal salvation. I will be only too glad to see you anytime you find it convenient to make the trip. Rest assured that I shall continue to remember you and yours in my prayers ..
